explanation: Accepted the repository-first YouTube Operational Hardening & Batch Readiness Campaign v1. Identity governance, exact-input manifests, quota/checkpoint/idempotency, per-video isolation, drift, Deep Audit, sanitized KU2A intake, tiers, gates, deterministic scenarios, and regression coverage are accepted at offline/simulated level only. The current tier remains identity_review_required because there are zero usable reviewed canonical Q-Diving video identities. The smallest next step is a separately bounded public YouTube discovery pass that may identify candidate canonical video identities for Human Review; because P37 explicitly keeps live discovery as a human gate, that discovery requires explicit human authority before any request. This review does not authorize comments, captions, transcript content, OAuth, production, scheduler, authority promotion, or broader batch execution.
